{{Top|leg}}
The '''source ripper''' interface allowed a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to see the original coding used to create a computer system. This gave unprecedented access to sub-systems that even the programmer might not have known existed.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
